<includeonly>{{#invoke:Infobox|main
|kind=dmz-structure
|sep=,
|title={{#if:{{{title|}}}|{{{title}}}|{{#invoke:Labels|name}}}}
|image={{#invoke:Labels|image|{{{image|}}}}}
|caption={{{caption|}}}
|sections=Summary, General, Content

|Summary=Quote
|Summary_nolabel=yes
|Quote_nolabel=yes
|Quote={{#if:{{{quote|}}}|''{{{quote}}}''}}

|General=Dimension, Biome, Location, Locate
|General_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|General}}
|Dimension_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Dimension}}
|Biome_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Biome}}
|Location_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Location}}
|Locate_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Locate}}
|Locate={{#if:{{{Locate|}}}|<code>{{{Locate}}}</code>}}

|Content=Inhabitants, Purpose, Protection
|Content_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Content}}
|Inhabitants_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Inhabitants}}
|Purpose_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Purpose}}
|Protection_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Protection}}
}}[[Category:Structures{{#translation:}}]]</includeonly><noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>
